Azerbaijani

[edit]
Azerbaijani Wikipedia has an article on:
abajur
Wikipedia az
Other scripts
Cyrillic абажур
Arabic آباژۇر

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Russian абажур (abažur), ultimately from French abat-jour.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [ɑbɑˈʒur]
  • Audio:(file)
  • Audio:(file)
  • Hyphenation: a‧ba‧jur

Noun

[edit]

abajur (definite accusative abajuru, plural abajurlar)

  1. lampshade

abajur
Wikipedia pt

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • abat-jour
  • abaju, abajour

Etymology

[edit]

    Borrowed from French abat-jour.

    Pronunciation

    [edit]
     
    • (Brazil) IPA(key): /a.baˈʒuʁ/ [a.baˈʒuh]
    • (Brazil) IPA(key): /a.baˈʒuʁ/ [a.baˈʒuh]
      • (São Paulo) IPA(key): /a.baˈʒuɾ/
      • (Rio de Janeiro) IPA(key): /a.baˈʒuʁ/ [a.baˈʒuχ]
      • (Caipira) IPA(key): /a.baˈʒuɻ/
     
    • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ɐ.baˈʒuɾ/ [ɐ.βaˈʒuɾ], /a.baˈʒuɾ/ [a.βaˈʒuɾ]
    • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ɐ.baˈʒuɾ/ [ɐ.βaˈʒuɾ], /a.baˈʒuɾ/ [a.βaˈʒuɾ]
      • (Southern Portugal) IPA(key): /ɐ.baˈʒu.ɾi/ [ɐ.βaˈʒu.ɾi], /a.baˈʒu.ɾi/ [a.βaˈʒu.ɾi]

    • Audio (Brazil):(file)
    • Hyphenation: a‧ba‧jur

    Noun

    [edit]

    abajur m (plural abajures)

    1. lampshade (cover over a lamp)
      Synonyms: abaixa-luz, quebra-luz
    2. (Brazil, metonymic) table lamp
      Synonym: candeeiro

    [edit]
